world: ⛔ UNVERIFIED ON IDENTIFICATION — the estimand fails G1 before power is even asked. The requirement TYPE was never stored as a field, so the population of entries whose requirement is `a second release / corpus` is not recoverable from committed text: three instruments give 17, 9 and 7. 5 entries are affected AS A NUMERATOR, and no share is admissible. ⭐ THE REPAIR IS STRUCTURAL, NOT ANALYTIC: store the requirement type when the entry is WRITTEN.
